entities.name: Mustafa Kandıralı
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Originally named Mustafa Kadıoğlu, he was a Turkish clarinetist of classical Turkish art music, Turkish folk music and gypsy music. He was a world renowned virtuoso and played in many international jazz festivals.
